entities.name: Probable IspD/IspF
observations: 381-aa query has 33.4–35.1% identity and 97.6–99.0% query coverage to reviewed bacterial bifunctional IspD/IspF proteins; functional transfer remains homology-based.
Probable bifunctional activities: MEP cytidylyltransferase (EC 2.7.7.60) and ME-cPP synthase (EC 4.6.1.12).

entities.name: MEP isoprenoid biosynthesis
observations: Homolog annotations associate the protein with methylerythritol phosphate pathway steps 2 and 4 of isopentenyl diphosphate biosynthesis; GO biological-process terms include GO:0019288 and terpenoid biosynthesis GO:0016114.
